blocks.text: Check our Miss Universe 2026 live updates page to get the latest news and features Jennifer Barreto of Puerto Rico emerged as the 2026 Miss Universe titleholder, besting over 100 delegates including the Philippines’ Bea Millan-Windorski, who finished as third runner up. The Top 5 finalists also included Dominican Republic’s Melissa Núñez, Venezuela’s Clara Vegas, and New Zealand’s Georgia Waddington who respectively finished as the first, second and fourth runners-up. Among the segments that helped determine the finalists’ fate was the question-and-answer portion, which saw each of them face two rounds of questions.
